AaSupport::all: Jadix supports analytic per-primitive Area, Balanced/High/Reference and explicit SampledScene2D 1/2/4/8/16/32/64 whole-scene spatial samples with one final resolve; native MSAA8/16 identities still differ.
AaSupport::area_only: GPU analytic pixel/triangle intersection area; independently clipped CPU f64 reference. Curves are tessellated; raw meshes must be non-overlapping, stencil-only expert fills reject. Different from Vello signed winding integration.
DrawGlyphs::new: Jadix uses immutable prepared glyph runs rather than a borrowed scene builder.
DrawGlyphs::brush: Inherited fill brushes for monochrome outlines; native color paints retain font colors.
DrawGlyphs::brush_alpha: Alpha affects complete draw/glyph according to prepared color semantics.
DrawGlyphs::brush_transform: Explicit brush-local affine, combined with current transform.
DrawGlyphs::draw: Prepared hinted/expanded outline drawing and native COLR paths. Native color glyph hint/embolden does not use monochrome options.
DrawGlyphs::font_embolden: Same Kurbo expand_path engine, independent x/y amounts, join/miter/tolerance; explicit finite input limits. Prepared monochrome outlines, not native COLR paints or advance recalculation.
DrawGlyphs::font_size: Font size participates in preparation and cache identity.
DrawGlyphs::glyph_transform: Glyph-local affine before baseline translation, plus independent transforms per glyph. Canvas/run global transforms remain separate; public coordinate convention is Y-down.
DrawGlyphs::hint: Skrifa default HintingInstance on scalable outlines at preparation ppem, plus existing Swash text atlas. Canvas transforms do not rehint; native COLR paint graph remains unhinted.
DrawGlyphs::normalized_coords: Exact post-avar F2Dot14 axis-order coordinates for prepared monochrome outlines. Does not retroactively change external shaping/advances.
Renderer::new: Different pipeline architecture and configuration; supports RGBA8 sRGB and RGBA16F targets.
Renderer::render_to_texture: Jadix caller target is render attachment; Vello uses RGBA8 storage output; alpha/encoding must be normalized before comparisons.
Renderer::override_image: Per-renderer GPU texture overrides with immutable CPU fallback, shared by nested group renderers. Requires same device and TEXTURE_BINDING or COPY_SRC, explicit color/alpha; converts to cached linear FP16 on GPU.
Renderer::mark_override_image_dirty: Explicit revision invalidation; refreshes image/mask/pattern caches on next encode. Current implementation clears image/layer caches and may reallocate on dirty.
Renderer::register_texture: GPU-only image handles with transparent CPU fallback. RGBA/BGRA8 or RGBA16F, single-sample D2; <=16M pixels and <=4096 registrations and <=64M total pixels. Optional GPU-only FP16 mip generation, independent cropped domains and sampled-scene registry snapshots. Different resource preconditions from Vello COPY_SRC.
Renderer::unregister_texture: Restores original CPU fallback for subsequent GPU frames, invalidates nested caches, drops registration references. Submitted work keeps owned resources; submit pending encoders before registry mutations.
Scene::new: Recorded callback or direct Canvas recording.
Scene::reset: Clear/reset a handle with copy-on-write snapshot isolation. Unique command storage retains capacity, clones/subscenes remain unchanged. Rerecord validates atomically in a fresh command vector; not Vello mutable Encoding storage.
Scene::append: Nested reusable shared scenes with appended transform and optional isolation.
Scene::fill: Solid/gradient/image brushes, explicit affine and fill rule.
Scene::stroke: User-space stroke geometry, caps/joins/miter/dashes and arbitrary brushes.
Scene::draw_image: Nearest/Bilinear plus explicit 4x4 Mitchell Bicubic and 6x6 Lanczos3 on CPU/GPU; source crops clamp every tap, float/predefined-space and caller GPU textures. Explicit NPOT linear-premultiplied mip chains with Trilinear / bounded 16-tap Anisotropic / Gaussian elliptical Ewa sampling; GPU-only region imports can generate NPOT mip chains lazily without source readback; independently prefilter atlas crops with mipmapped_region; negative-lobe ringing clamp differs by source-domain contract.
Scene::draw_glyphs: Low-level scalable hint/embolden/normalized/local transforms now available; color glyph graph remains a distinct preparation path.
Scene::push_layer: Blend/composition/opacity plus arbitrary filters and final clip/mask. Rasterization/region semantics differ.
Scene::push_clip_layer: Save/restore path mask clips, or final layer clips. Explicit PathGeometry2D Intersection resolves clip/subject geometry before AA and avoids correlated identical-edge coverage multiplication; existing mask clip semantics are unchanged. SampledScene2D additionally retains per-sample clips, painter order and group composition until one final resolve; finite ordered grid, not analytic exact scene integration.
Scene::push_luminance_mask_layer: Premultiplied luminance mask; invert extension available.
Scene::pop_layer: Closes an isolated group, applies ordered filters, then composition.
Scene::draw_blurred_rounded_rect: Gaussian support differs: Jadix 4 sigma cutoff, independent corners/inset extension, not identical Vello 2.5 sigma clipping.
Scene::draw_blurred_rounded_rect_in: Arbitrary shape clip composition through existing Canvas state.
Scene::encoding: Jadix triangle/brush/group ops are not Vello compute encoding.
Scene::encoding_mut: Editable owned prepared ops, not the same binary encoding.
Scene::bump_estimate: Checked CPU replay/tessellation with explicit target and transform estimates geometry, vertex/Area payloads, unique images and conservative layer/target surfaces. Not Vello compute bump-buffer ABI or process/driver allocation guarantee.
RendererOptions::use_cpu: Actual complete CPU drawing/clip/filter/composition followed by an FP16 upload/export pass; unlike Vello CPU coarse stages plus GPU fine rasterization. GPU-only source registrations require CPU fallback pixels.
RendererOptions::num_init_threads: Explicit bounded native pipeline initialization workers over currently needed material jobs. macOS defaults to one, WebAssembly always serial. Not identical Vello stage scheduling.
RendererOptions::pipeline_cache: Caller-owned same-device wgpu PipelineCache propagated to owned leaf/layer/filter/import/mip/sample-resolve pipelines. Persistent cache data tested on Vulkan; wgpu does not supply the same persistence on DX12. Independent GpuMesh pipelines remain separate.
RendererOptions: Explicit CPU execution, initialization threads, same-device wgpu cache and quality options. CPU algorithm and AA behavior differ; see individual field rows.
